goals.primaryObjective: Generate 300 registrants and 50 sales-qualified leads from the mid-market marketing operations segment.
objectives: Produce three on-demand clips for the nurture sequence
Test the new partner co-promotion motion on a low-risk event
goals.businessJustification: Mid-market pipeline is 22% below plan for the half and the segment responds better to practical tooling content than to product demos. A webinar is the cheapest repeatable format to test the co-promotion motion before committing to a field event.

audience.description: Mid-market marketing operations leads and demand-gen managers evaluating automation tooling in the next two quarters, primarily in North America and the UK.

targetPersonas.name: Hands-on evaluator
targetPersonas.title: Marketing Operations Manager
targetPersonas.description: Registers to learn whether the approach solves a live problem; will trade an email address for a practical walkthrough they can act on the same week.
painPoints: Has sat through too many webinars that were 45 minutes of product pitch
Owns the tooling decision but has no budget authority

attendeeValue.promise: Find out in 45 minutes whether a retrofit pays back before you commission a study
takeaways: A payback model you can run on your own line
The three questions to ask any automation vendor

allocations.notes: Webinar platform seat and streaming overage
Paid social plus partner list co-promotion
Editing the on-demand cut and three clips

budget.notes: Partner covers half of the promotion spend against their own list.

venueOrPlatform.name: Zoom Webinar
venueOrPlatform.notes: 11:00–11:45 ET including 10 minutes of live Q&A.

successMetrics.notes: Total form completions before air date

riskRegister.risk: Registration volume falls short because the topic or promo list is too narrow
riskRegister.mitigation: Confirm the combined list supports 300 at a 2.5% conversion rate before committing; add paid budget if pacing is behind at T-14.

riskRegister.risk: Webinar platform outage or streaming failure during the live session
riskRegister.mitigation: Dry run on the production account on 15 Jun, backup host assigned, pre-recorded cut ready, and a 'recording to follow' email drafted.

riskRegister.risk: Speaker cancels close to air date
riskRegister.mitigation: Confirm in writing by 21 May, slides due 11 Jun, and Sam Whitfield rehearses as the internal backup.

riskRegister.risk: High registration but low live attendance
riskRegister.mitigation: Reminders at 1 week, 1 day and 15 minutes; calendar invite on registration; on-demand path promoted to no-shows within 48 hours.

milestones.label: Landing page live and registration opens
Recording published and follow-up email sent
Leads scored, routed to sales, and ROI report published

items: Must air before the end of Q2 to count toward the half
Partner co-promotion requires their brand review 10 days before launch
No gated content beyond the registration form — legal signed off on one form only
constraints.notes: Reuse the Q1 landing page template; no new design resource is available this quarter.

carryForwardLessons.lesson: Send the 15-minute reminder — live attendance jumped 9 points the one time we did it.
